question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2766202685c586808aa0605ba9156a621ba11faf7db00b1a67d544d6c6121d27.png] 

 

All follow the same pattern, except 'ZCGLS’.

Hence, “**ZCGLS**” is the odd one.
